sql: SELECT p.id FROM people p WHERE p.workspace_id = $1 AND p.merged_into IS NULL AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND e.person_id = p.id AND e.name = $2::text AND e.occurred_at > $3::timestamptz AND e.occurred_at <= $4::timestamptz) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events e WHERE e.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND e.person_id = p.id AND e.name = $2::text AND e.occurred_at > $5::timestamptz AND e.occurred_at <= $4::timestamptz)))
